headlines.description: Gardner Minshew threw two touchdown passes and should have had a third, Calais Campbell spearheaded another defensive gem and the Jacksonville Jaguars beat the Tennessee Titans 20-7 in sloppy conditions Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Minshew, defense shine as Jaguars thump Titans 20-7

headlines.description: Frank Gore scored on a 1-yard run with 1:50 remaining in rallying the Buffalo Bills to a home-opening 21-17 victory over the winless Cincinnati Bengals on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills stay unbeaten by rallying back to beat Bengals 21-17

headlines.description: Dak Prescott threw two touchdown passes to Amari Cooper before running for another score, and the Dallas Cowboys pulled out of a first-half funk as huge favorites in a 31-6 victory over the Miami Dolphins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Prescott, Cowboys get out of funk, ease past Dolphins 31-6

events.name: Denver Broncos at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw for 235 yards and a touchdown, Aaron Jones tied a career high by running for two scores, and the Green Bay Packers beat the Denver Broncos 27-16 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers remain unbeaten with 27-16 win over Broncos

headlines.description: Jacoby Brissett threw two touchdown passes in the first half Sunday, and Marlon Mack scored on a 4-yard run in the fourth quarter to lead the Indianapolis Colts past Atlanta 27-24.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brissett's fast start helps Colts hold off Falcons 27-24

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs won a showdown between two of the NFL's top offenses.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mahomes throws 3 TD passes as Chiefs hold off Ravens, 33-28

headlines.description: NFL rushing leader Dalvin Cook cruised past the 100-yard mark for the third straight game, Kirk Cousins rebounded from his rattled performance the week before with a turnover-free afternoon, and the Minnesota Vikings rolled by the Oakland Raiders...
headlines.shortLinkText: NFL rushing leader Cook leads Vikes romp past Raiders 34-14

events.name: New York Jets at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw a pair of touchdown passes and the Patriots didn't allow a defensive touchdown for the third straight week as New England dominated in a 30-14 win over the New York Jets on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady, Patriots defense shine in 30-14 win over Jets

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford threw a touchdown pass to Marvin Jones, Jamal Agnew returned a kickoff 100 yards for a score and the Detroit Lions held on for a 27-24 victory over the Philadelphia Eagles on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stafford, Agnew lead Lions over Eagles 27-24

headlines.description: Kyle Allen threw for 261 yards and four touchdowns in place of the injured Cam Newton, Christian McCaffrey ran for a 76-yard touchdown, and the Carolina Panthers beat the Arizona Cardinals 38-20 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Allen throws 4 TDs, Panthers beat Cardinals 38-20

events.name: New York Giants at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: The Daniel Jones era is off to a rousing start for the New York Giants.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jones sparkles in his start, Giants rally past Bucs 32-31

events.name: Houston Texans at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: Deshaun Watson threw for 351 yards and hit Jordan Akins with two of his three touchdown passes, and J.J. Watt had two of the Texans' five sacks of Philip Rivers in their 27-20 victory over the Los Angeles Chargers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Watson, Watt lead way as Texans outlast Chargers, 27-20

headlines.description: Jimmy Garoppolo threw a 5-yard touchdown pass to Dante Pettis with 1:15 remaining and the San Francisco 49ers overcame five turnovers to beat the Pittsburgh Steelers 24-20 on Sunday for their first 3-0 start in 21 years.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sloppy 49ers beat Steelers 24-20 on late Garoppolo TD pass

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: Teddy Bridgewater threw two touchdown passes in his first start in place of Drew Brees, New Orleans also scored TDs on defense and special teams, and the Saints beat the Seattle Seahawks 33-27 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: No Brees, no problem: Bridgewater, Saints top Seahawks 33-27

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: Cooper Kupp's comeback is complete. The Rams have another weapon.
headlines.shortLinkText: Goff throws 2 TDs passes, Rams hold off Browns 20-13

headlines.description: Mitchell Trubisky threw his first three touchdown passes of the season, all to Taylor Gabriel in the second quarter, to finally get the Chicago Bears' offense going and build a big lead that held up to beat the Washington Redskins 31-15 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trubisky, Bears get offense on track, beat Redskins 31-15
